name: Kyon's Sister
source:
Age: 10-12/11
Occupation: Student

Nonoko ([url=/c71227]Kyon[/url]'s Sister) is a 6th grade student. As her name suggests, she is the younger sister of [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url]. She spread around the nickname "[url=/c71227]Kyon[/url]" and caused everyone to call him that. She is known to the SOS Brigade as "Little Sister".
